question: My machine has CUDA 12.4 (per nvidia-smi). I want to use cuopt from Python. What do I install and how do I verify?
ground_truth: The agent matches the package CUDA suffix to the runtime CUDA. For CUDA 12.x, the correct pip command is 'pip install --extra-index-url=https://pypi.nvidia.com cuopt-cu12'. The agent does not suggest a cu13 package on a CUDA 12 system. Verification: 'import cuopt; print(cuopt.__version__)'.
expected_behavior: Matches the package suffix to the runtime CUDA (cuopt-cu12 for CUDA 12.x) and does not suggest cu13
Provides the pip command with the NVIDIA extra-index-url
Provides a Python verification snippet (import cuopt; cuopt.__version__)
